what: The gauntlet-2 adversarial fixtures (2026-09-06), ported unchanged from the probe scratchpad into the tracked corpus so every finding in that round has a permanent repro.
served_by: tests/browser/test_gauntlet2_fixes.py over a local 127.0.0.1 HTTP server; nothing here reaches the network.

pages.creds.html: Six fields: a real password, current-password on a type=text, one-time-code, a type=text that becomes type=password on focus, a cc-number payment field, and one ordinary control. Plus a password inside an open shadow root. C1, M6, and the credential-blindness held lines.
pages.plain.html: A 'Delete account' form with no payment field. H1: implicit form submission through Enter.
pages.phantom.html: One button a human sees and five it does not: transparent foreground and background, opacity 0.01, filter opacity(0), blur(40px), an opaque lid, and a visibility:visible child of a visibility:hidden parent. H2 and L2.
pages.cloak_light.html: Nine marked payloads across nine techniques, including a collapsed <details>, content-visibility hidden and auto, clip-path, an overlay, contain, and scale(0). H3.
pages.shadow_cloak.html: The same three techniques wrapped around an OPEN shadow root, plus inert. H3's shadow half. Fix wave 9c also uses it for the reverse defect: get_text filtered the three hidden components correctly and then measured what it had withheld with textContent, which stops at the shadow boundary, so the stripped ledger read zero on a page where three injection payloads had been suppressed.
pages.cloak_extract.html: insane-sonnet-2's own repro (2026-09-08): a 'Balance:' label whose value paragraph sits in a positioned wrapper with the opaque lid INSIDE that wrapper, so extract_page's proximate match landed on the wrapper, passed the cloak check there, and returned the covered value underneath it as a found/proximate/exact fact.
pages.cloak_extract2.html: The same construction built independently around a 'Recovery code:' label, which is what made the leak a class rather than one fixture's geometry.
pages.cloak_boundary.html: insane-sonnet-2's six boundary probes for the read-side cloak rule on one page: a translucent modal scrim, a half-covered box, a 0.9-alpha cover, a 0.97-alpha cover, a total opaque cover, and an in-flow static cover. Five must stay readable and two must be excluded, which is the alpha threshold and the out-of-flow predicate tested at their exact documented edges rather than through the shipped suite's own cases.
pages.cloak_article.html: An article-shaped page with one paint-cloaked paragraph among three ordinary ones, because cloak_light.html does not clear get_article's shape threshold and therefore cannot test that surface at all.
pages.cloak_ordinary.html: Fix wave 9c's false-positive battery for the read-side cloak rule: nine out-of-flow lids that satisfy every one of its box conditions and paint nothing over the prose beneath them (a publisher's continue-reading gradient, a photo scrim, clip-path, a transparent mask, a decorative svg, an undrawn canvas, a spacer img, mix-blend-mode, and an iframe overlay), plus one plain opaque box as the control that must still be excluded and counted. Every one of the nine came back withheld on c0145ac.
pages.cloak_values.html: The class sweep: one paint-cloaked value per VALUE-harvesting surface (a data-table cell, a list item, a DD, a two-column row, an aria-labelled container, a tier-3 proximate pair, and a form field's label), so get_table, get_list, extract_fields, extract_page, and get_text can be checked against one page in one run.
pages.poison.html: Closed roots created with a pristine attachShadow lifted from a same-origin iframe, a zeroed counter, a Map subclass over the ref registry, a mint-time DOM swap, and a rename under a reused id. H4 and H5.
pages.order.html: Four reorderings of the same eight sentences: flex column-reverse, the order property, grid-template-areas placement, and slot order inside an open root. M3.
pages.scope.html: A component whose open root slots its light children into a labelled panel, plus a light child no slot ever assigns. M5 and M4's converse.
pages.geo.html: Elements parked off-screen, sized to zero, and coloured to match their background. M4.
pages.ambig.html: Five buttons whose accessible names are instruction text. M1.
pages.blank.html: The navigation target every form on these pages submits to.
